alternatives.name: ORDER_BOOK_SNAPSHOT_WHALE_EVENT_WITH_IMBALANCE_OFI
tradeoffs: Full snapshot replay is simpler than incremental delta replay; imbalance and OFI are derived with explicit provenance.

negative: Direction from imbalance alone remains ambiguous without trade confirmation; no participant identity may be invented.
positive: order_book family can surface entitled fixture depth snapshots without collapsing into a universal whale score.

decision.summary: Order-book whale events use whale_event payloads with family order_book, snapshot_time, level_count, best_bid, best_ask, bid_size, ask_size, imbalance_ratio (DERIVED), ofi_value (DERIVED), direction_label (supports_long|supports_short|neutral|ambiguous), and snapshot_provenance (fixture_synthetic|entitled_live). PIT queries exclude snapshots whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. Visible liquidity is not participant intent.
decision.title: Order book whale envelope semantics and snapshot policy

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first order_book on ADMITTED-L2-NVDA-001 only. Live L2 feeds and paper execution require separate entitlement records.
